procedure utb_to_utrs
 is
 temp_test_seq_no number;
--
 cursor c1 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no,
 test_state, test_mode,
 result_status_1, result_status_2,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no,
 well_number, absorbance, ratio, result_dats,
 result_user_id, testing_lab_code, cancel_flag
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:components.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is not null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_2 is null and
 cancel_flag is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
--
 cursor c3 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no, insert_Dats,
 insert_user_id, program_id
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:components.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
begin
 begin
--
-- it is possible that interdictions were created
-- from test results at a time when the unit was not
-- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in unit_interdictions.
-- This is updated the first unit is checked
-- in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here as units from different chapters might
-- actually get the same chapter_id.
--
 update unit_interdictions
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :components.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
--
 if (:disp_system_label_decision in ('47','58') and :GLOBAL.code_scheme != 'I') then
 -- insert_interdictions; commented for SCR: 151866
 insert_unit_interdictions; --TR 1225
 elsif (:disp_system_label_decision in ('Mx', 'Md', 'Mb', 'Mq', '98' , '54' , '09' , '65' , '20' , '76' , '31' , '87') and :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I') then --added by diptia to insert into unit_interdictions as per Kim
 ---insert_unit_interdictions; commented for SCR: 151866
 insert_interdictions; -- Wanted to place the interdiction only at the component level.
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
--
-- it is possible that tests were created in utrs
-- at a time when the unit was not checked-in at all,
-- specially for antigens. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in utrs.
-- This is updated when the first unit is checked
-- in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here as units from different chapters might
-- actually get the same chapter_id.
--
 update utrs
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :components.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in updating utrs - coll_date/chapter_id is null');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
--
-- it is possible that attributes were created
-- from test results at a time when the unit was not
-- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in unit_attributes.
-- This is updated the first unit is checked
-- in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here as units from different chapters might
-- actually get the same chapter_id.
--
 update unit_attributes
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :components.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
--
-- it is possible that transactions were created
-- in unit_test_base when the unit was not
-- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in
-- unit_test_base. This is updated when the first unit
-- is checked in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here in case of collision between unit_ids from
-- two different chapters.
--
 update unit_test_base
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :components.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit test base');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- The following block moves transactions from utb to utrs
-- The sequence of utr activity is as follows:
-- 1. Insert transcations in utr from profile tests
-- 2. Insert transcations in utr from transactions in utb
-- which were scheduled from the core routine. and the
-- test results have still not come. These can be
-- identified by tb_id being null.
-- 3. Update results from utb to utrs as present.
-- 4. Transfer all reconciled tests from UTB to UTR(as left in UTB)
--
--
-- Step .1.
--
 insert_utrs;
--
-- Step .2.
--
 begin
 for c3_rec in c3
 loop
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 test_seq_no, test_id, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id)
 select :components.unit_id , :components.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1, c3_rec.test_id,
 c3_rec.insert_dats, c3_rec.insert_user_id,
 c3_rec.program_id
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id
 and coll_date = :components.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = c3_rec.test_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into utrs from utb');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id
 and coll_date = :components.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = c3_rec.test_seq_no;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in deleting from utb - 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Step .3.
 --
 begin
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 begin
 select min(test_seq_no)
 into temp_test_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:components.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and
 result_status_1 is null and
 cancel_flag is null;
 if nvl(temp_test_seq_no,0) >= 1
 then
 begin
 update utrs
 set test_state = c1_rec.test_state,
 test_mode = c1_rec.test_mode,
 result_status_1 = c1_rec.result_status_1,
 result_status_2 = c1_rec.result_status_2,
 tb_id = c1_rec.tb_id,
 test_chapter_id = c1_rec.test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no = c1_rec.tb_seq_no,
 well_number = c1_rec.well_number,
 absorbance = c1_rec.absorbance,
 ratio = c1_rec.ratio,
 result_dats = c1_rec.result_dats,
 result_user_id = c1_rec.result_user_id,
 testing_lab_code = c1_rec.testing_lab_code
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:components.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_test_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating utr');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no,
 test_id, test_state, test_mode, result_status_1,
 result_status_2, tb_id, test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance, ratio,
 result_dats, result_user_id, testing_lab_code,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id, cancel_flag,
 program_id)
 select :components.unit_id, :components.coll_date, :global.chapter_id,
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1,
 c1_rec.test_id, c1_rec.test_state,
 c1_rec.test_mode, c1_rec.result_status_1,
 c1_rec.result_status_2, c1_rec.tb_id,
 c1_rec.test_chapter_id, c1_rec.tb_seq_no,
 c1_rec.well_number, c1_rec.absorbance,
 c1_rec.ratio, c1_rec.result_dats,
 c1_rec.result_user_id,
 c1_rec.testing_lab_code,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 c1_rec.cancel_flag, :banner.prog_name
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:components.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in transferring from UTB to UTR');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :components.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:components.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = c1_rec.test_seq_no;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in deleting from utb - 2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
end;

PROCEDURE SRVDON_CHECK (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_aliquot in varchar2)

IS
 ret_val varchar2(5); 
 v_msg varchar2(200);
 nExists NUMBER:=0;
 srvdon_excpt exception;
BEGIN
 
 
 Begin
 ret_val := SRVDON.donor_acceptable(p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 p_aliquot,
 FALSE);
 
 IF ret_val = 'FALSE' THEN
 v_msg:='Donor Not Acceptable-placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'NOREG' THEN
 v_msg:='Donation Not Registered -placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'NODON' THEN
 v_msg:='Donor Not Attacged -placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'HOLD' THEN
 v_msg:='Hold Interdiction-placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'QUAR' THEN
 v_msg:='Quarantine Product -placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'UNKN' THEN
 v_msg:='Unknown Hold Flag-placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'RTNDF' THEN
 v_msg:='Donor has not returned -placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'INTST' THEN
 v_msg:='Incomplete Testing -placing CHAP inter';
 ELSIF ret_val = 'DHOLD' THEN
 v_msg:='Donor on Hold -placing CHAP inter';
 ELSE
 raise srvdon_excpt;
 END IF;
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nExists from component_interdictions where unit_id=p_unit_id and
 inter_code='CHAP' and product_code=p_product_code and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 
 If nExists = 0 then 
 show_error('9610',': '||v_msg);
 Begin 
 insert into component_interdictions (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, audit_key,program_id)
 values (p_unit_id,p_coll_date,:global.chapter_id,p_product_code,'CHAP',
 sysdate,substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5,length(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)),0,'IMCHKIN');
 Exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 End; 
 End If; 
 Exception
 WHEN srvdon_excpt then 
 null;
 WHEN others then
 handle_error; 
 End; 
END;
